title: PrivacyGuard Unified Dataset Schema
description: Unified specification for PrivacyGuard benchmark evaluation dataset and ground-truth annotations.

evaluation_cases.csv.description: Unified evaluation dataset containing all valid source cases across domains, formats, and risk profiles.

case_id.description: Unique identifier corresponding exactly to the source document UUID.

text.description: Original raw text content preserved without modification.

contains_pii.description: Binary indicator specifying whether any PII entity is present in the text.

pii_types.description: Semicolon-separated list of distinct PII categories present, or 'NONE' if no PII is present.

risk_level.description: Privacy risk category based on entity sensitivity, quantity, and re-identification potential.

domain.description: Professional or contextual domain of the case.

format_type.description: Structural format and style of the text.

annotation_status.description: Validation status indicating whether ground-truth spans are verified or require manual review.

annotated_cases.json.description: Granular ground-truth PII entity annotations with character-level offsets.

offset_conventions.interval: [start, end) where start is inclusive and end is exclusive
offset_conventions.invariant: For any entity e, text[e.start:e.end] == e.text

supported_pii_labels.NAME_STUDENT: Full or partial names of individuals, students, or professionals.
supported_pii_labels.STREET_ADDRESS: Physical residential, studio, or corporate street addresses.
supported_pii_labels.USERNAME: Online user handles, usernames, or account IDs.
supported_pii_labels.URL_PERSONAL: Personal URLs, portfolios, or web links.

risk_level_rules.NONE: 0 PII entities present in the record.
risk_level_rules.MEDIUM: Direct personal identifier only (NAME_STUDENT) without physical address or direct contact info.
risk_level_rules.HIGH: Contains direct contact channels (PHONE_NUM, EMAIL) or physical location (STREET_ADDRESS).
risk_level_rules.CRITICAL: Composite identity disclosure: NAME_STUDENT combined with physical address and contact channel (PHONE_NUM or EMAIL).

annotation_rules.strict_offsets: All entity offsets must precisely align with the original text string.
annotation_rules.no_fabrication: Ground-truth annotations must originate from validated token-level source labels.
annotation_rules.uncertainty_flagging: Cases with untagged prompt metadata or ambiguous boundaries are flagged as 'needs_review' rather than fabricated.
annotation_rules.unified_representation: All cases (PII, non-PII, multilingual, multi-entity) reside in one single dataset file.
